introText: Use your account email to set a new password and return to your bookings.
requestNote: Enter your account email to request a recovery code.
resetNote: Enter the six-digit code. It expires after ten minutes; use the most recent code you requested.
requested: If recovery is available for this account, an email with a code will arrive. Check your inbox and spam folder.
resendAfter: Request a new code in {seconds} seconds
successNote: Sign in with your new password. Previous sessions for this account have been revoked.
uncertain: We could not confirm the request result. Try signing in with your new password before requesting another reset.
